st: The Case of the Gilded Lily
d: Perry Mason seeks to free his client of a murder charge after a blackmailer is found dead.

st: The Case of the Lazy Lover
d: Perry Mason receives an unexplained check for $2500 in the mail and later finds himself defending its sender on a murder charge.

st: The Case of the Prodigal Parent
d: Perry Mason is retained by a divorcee to defend her ex-husband in the slaying of his stepson.

st: The Case of the Black-Eyed Blonde
d: Wearing a bathrobe and sporting a black eye, the beautiful Diana Reynolds enters Perry Mason's legal life.

st: The Case of the Terrified Typist
d: Perry Mason is hired by a South African diamond company to defend onf of its employees on a murder charge.

st: The Case of the Rolling Bones
d: Attempts to commit a wealthy man to a mental institution brings a new kind of challenge to Perry Mason, especially when the case is interrupted by murder.

st: The Case Of The Thistle Killer
d: Sherlock Holmes helps to track down a killer who leaves clues next to the women he kills.

st: The Case of the Corresponding Corpse
d: A complex case ensues after Perry Mason receives a telephone call, supposedly from a man whose funeral he attended three years earlier.

st: The Case of the Lucky Loser
d: In defense of his client, Perry Mason quotes a constitutional provision concerning double jeopardy.

st: The Case of the Pint-Sized Client
d: A thirteen year old boy gets Perry Mason involved in one of the toughest cases of his career.

st: The Case of the Sardonic Sergeant
d: Perry Mason is hired by the wife of an Army officer to represent him before a court-martial on a murder charge, but when he appears at the man's Army post, he finds his client dead.

st: The Case of the Curious Bride
d: Perry Mason finds himself neck-deep in blackmail, embezzlement, and murder.

st: The Case of the Buried Clock
d: After a man asked for advice in a case dealing with embezzlement and blackmail, it's only a matter of time before Perry Mason is defending the man on a murder charge.

st: The Case of the Married Moonlighter
d: Fighting to stay ahead of his creditors by working two jobs, a schoolteacher plays the Good Samaritan by taking a drunk friend home, only to find himself charged with murder.

st: The Case of the Jilted Jockey
d: Famous jockey Billy Pearson makes his acting debut in the role of Tic Barton, a jockey charged with murder.

st: The Case of the Purple Woman
d: An old and valuable painting - or perhaps, a very good forgery of it - and the murder of an art dealer figure prominently in this mystery drama.

st: The Case of the Fancy Figures
d: Perry Mason helps free a man who has been unjustly imprisoned for five years but later has to defend him on a murder charge.
Parliament considers a bill against prostitution when a sex trade scandal hits the news.
